MYCA / CANDIDATE REVIEW 0.1 / 9 OCTOBER 2026

Definitive canon sheet
shortlist

Five candidates, ranked for building a reliable reference set. Design fidelity takes priority over rendering polish.

Recommended base: R30. R08 retains authority over the selected leg proportions and lichen; R11 anchors terminal geometry. R28 and R20 supply conditional overview and material detail.

Recommendation pending creator selection. This review does not promote any complete sheet into canon, change the design baseline or replace the separate locomotion guide.

How to read the order

Higher rank means greater usefulness for assembling the next definitive sheet, not permission to override a more specific approved feature. The assessment considers settled-rule fidelity, creator selection, readable geometry, consistency, crop safety and complementary coverage. Low-detail rendering is not itself a defect.

The displayed images are exact feature crops, not corrected drawings. The crop captions identify limitations. Full originals remain available in the resource for audit.

01

Lead whole-character base candidate

R30 · Soft-shaded three-pose sheet

The three poses keep the main colour masses, compact bob, restrained face, skirt/waistband relationship and clean pointed endings easy to inspect. Compared with R29, fewer competing effects and no lower-leg bands make it a cleaner starting point.

Evidence: Creator-supplied supporting reference. This lead ranking is an editorial recommendation, not recorded creator approval.

Retain: The readable overall character, compact head/hair mass, quiet face, and the lantern / pointing / seated gesture family.

Before finalising: Reduce calf fullness and restore the long narrow taper using R08 plus R11. Resolve the broad shallow cap as one object, restore small lichen construction and demonstrate internal tissue depth at detail scale. Do not infer fixed measurements from the poses.

Scope: Use as the base candidate to refine, not as authority over R08's selected proportions or R11's point geometry.

02

Strongest established proportion-and-hair authority

R08 · Selected proportions and lichen

It has the clearest feature-specific endorsement and preserves the unusually long, narrow paired tapers and recognisable bob texture. It must constrain a new base drawing even though it ranks second as a complete-page candidate.

Evidence: The creator explicitly selected this sheet's leg proportions and hair texture/feel while preferring another contact network.

Retain: Long-leg proportional relationship and the chosen lichen texture. Pair with the later calf-thinning instruction and the compact-bob rule.

Before finalising: Exclude the high crown, bright angular/node-like internal network, weak contact demonstration and mislabeled insets. The apparent fine facial anatomy is not separately approved.

Scope: Use only for the selected proportions and lichen. Do not feed its entire obsolete information sheet back as current canon.

03

Essential point-geometry and contact-state specialist

R11 · Continuous-point geometry study

The single terminal point is distinct from the temporary surrounding web, and the final airborne panel is clean. This is more useful for the core mechanical rule than the later release panels that still carry strands.

Evidence: The creator described the result as nearly perfect, then requested thinner calves and the proportions of the earlier selected sheet.

Retain: Uninterrupted terminal geometry; point at first touch; distinction between point and lateral emergence; a clean final release state.

Before finalising: Do not copy the calf bulk. Keep emergence immediately above the substrate, reduce the high-origin / thick radial strands, and let the separate locomotion specification govern the sequence.

Scope: C03 supports static character anatomy. C04-C06 belong to the separate locomotion module, not the condensed master prompt.

04

Conditional consolidated-overview candidate

R28 · Deep-Hyphae Reference Sheet

It covers the figure, eyes, gills, hair, tissue, limbs and contact process in one place. The eye detail is a useful volume reference, and the tissue tile is useful for comparing what the depth correction attempted.

Evidence: A revision produced in response to the explicit tissue-depth request; the previous overview R27 was praised. Neither event approves every detail on this sheet.

Retain: Feature coverage and selected glassy-eye / gill detail. Use the tissue inset as a review comparison, not a finished shader or texture specification.

Before finalising: Several networks still read as uniformly visible lines plus glow. Lower-leg bulk, cap/patch consistency, lip-like seam edges, human-specific surface artefacts and attached release strands remain issues.

Scope: A presentation candidate after corrections, not an all-feature authority. The name "Deep-Hyphae" is an asset label, not a passing review result.

05

Organic-filament and material-detail donor

R20 · Supplied material and pose interpretation

The hand/wrist detail offers fine, irregularly branching filaments with less of the overt star-node pattern in some earlier sheets. It adds a material reference that the cleaner base sheets cannot show at their scale.

Evidence: Creator-supplied supporting image; not a blanket design approval.

Retain: Selected hand/wrist filament texture and gentle observational gesture ideas, keeping the underlying body rules unchanged.

Before finalising: Do not inherit ordinary hair with attached foliage, humanised face/body details, fuller calves or the older cap crown. This image also does not fully settle the depth of every internal strand.

Scope: Use a caption-free material crop only. It is not the base body, head model or full locomotion reference.

Strong reserves

R31 is the clean simplification check. R18/C08 stays with terrain interaction. R16 supplies selected quiet gestures, not its whole mouth range. R27 preserves the earlier praised overview, but its surface-depth problem prevents it taking the lead. R12/R13 and their duplicates mostly add redundant or superseded information.

R29 remains a pose/effects reference: leg bands, conspicuous ears, longer hanging growth and angular luminous networks must not be adopted. Recent model-sheet layout and printed measurements are not evidence of approved anatomy.

The definitive build

R30 base + R08 proportions/lichen + R11 single-point geometry. Add R28's eye detail and R20's fine filaments only for those features. Apply the current written shallow-cap rule throughout. Keep locomotion references separate.

Not yet settled

A consistent low-profile cap and patch map across angles; the chosen slim calves and long points in one repeatable body; convincing internal filament depth rather than bright surface lines; a stable tiny mouth seam across expressions. No new numerical ratios, shader parameters or lore are approved here.

Source basis: the inspected Myca Library brief, reference index, decision trail, review checklist and visible creator feedback. Seven new lossless crops C09-C15; existing C03-C06 retain their original provenance. No new illustration or retouching.
